label: An accessible successor from the no-dead-end frame condition (inference)
rule: Apply excluded middle to successor existence and contradict the no-dead-end condition in the negative case
meaning: For one frame and selected world w, if all worlds satisfy the no-dead-end condition and excluded middle holds, there exists a world accessible from w. This gives the world witness used in finite roster amalgamation without assuming that w accesses itself. The witness need not be distinct or populated. The global no-dead-end premise is incomparable with self-access at a single selected world.
